body.statement: For every \(G\in\mathfrak G_{H,L}(\mathcal S)\) and every \(\mathcal M\in\mathfrak M(G,p)\), there exists \(\rho\in\mathfrak O_H(p)\) such that \(q_H^{\mathrm{ord}}(\rho)=q(\mathcal M)\). For each realization \(u=(u_a)_a\) of the mutually independent refinement latents, pad every \(f_v\) to the complete argument list \(\operatorname{Pred}_H(v)\) by fixing its latent inputs at \(u\) and ignoring every observed nonparent coordinate. The padded tables form a signature \(\xi(u)\in\Omega_H^{\mathrm{ord}}\). Define \(U^{\mathrm{ord}}=\xi((U_a)_a)\) and let \(\rho\) be its push-forward law. This construction preserves the observational recursion and both interventional recursions defining the CDE. Consequently, whenever \(\mathfrak F(\mathcal S,L,H,p)\ne\varnothing\), \([\underline q(p),\overline q(p)]\subseteq[\underline q_{\mathrm{ord}}(p),\overline q_{\mathrm{ord}}(p)]\).
body.justification: The comparator must be a genuine outer model for every graph-constrained refinement rather than a collection of sparse graphs carrying incompatible unrestricted latent masses.
body.gap: RossettoAntonucci2026 optimizes over complete signatures consistent with a causal order; this lemma gives the exact embedding from the present independent-edge-latent refinement fiber into that complete common-latent class while preserving the common micro CDE.
body.consumer: Every graph-aware interval can be compared to one well-defined order-only interval, and strict endpoint gains have a certified nesting baseline.
body.proof_tex:
Let \(G\in\mathfrak G_{H,L}(\mathcal S)\), \(\mathcal M\in\mathfrak M(G,p)\), and let \(u=(u_a)_a\) be a joint realization of its finite exogenous variables.  Every directed parent \(a=(U,s)\) of \(v=(V,t)\) satisfies \(s<t\) by \(\text{ass:positive-bounded-directed-lags}\); hence \(\operatorname{pa}_G(v)\subseteq\operatorname{Pred}_H(v)\).  Define the complete table
\[
g_{v,\xi(u)}(x_{\operatorname{Pred}_H(v)})
=f_v(x_{\operatorname{pa}_G(v)},(u_a:a\ni v)),
\tag{8}
\]
so the extra predecessor coordinates are ignored.  Equation (8), for all \(v\), is an element \(\xi(u)\in\Omega_H^{\mathrm{ord}}\).

Set \(U^{\mathrm{ord}}=\xi((U_a)_a)\) and let \(\rho\) be its push-forward law.  Conditional on the original latent realization \(u\), induction over increasing time shows that (8) and \(\text{ass:structural-recursion}\) return the same observed value at every vertex.  There are no within-time directed arrows, so the vertices in a common time layer may be checked in any order.  Averaging over \(u\) gives
\[
P_H^{\mathrm{ord}}(\rho)=p
\]
by \(\text{ass:observed-law-compatibility}\), and therefore \(\rho\in\mathfrak O_H(p)\).

Run the same induction after replacing the equations for \(X_{-\gamma}\) and \(Z\) by either intervention in \(\text{def:micro-cde}\).  The order-only tables and the refinement tables agree at every nonintervened vertex, conditional on the same \(u\).  Thus both intervention-specific outcomes agree pointwise, and subtraction followed by expectation gives
\[
q_H^{\mathrm{ord}}(\rho)=q(\mathcal M).
\tag{9}
\]
It follows that every element of \(\Theta(\mathcal S,L,H,p)\) belongs to the order-only attainable set.  Taking the minimum and maximum, which exist by the two finite compact response constructions, yields
\[
[\underline q(p),\overline q(p)]
\subseteq[\underline q_{\mathrm{ord}}(p),\overline q_{\mathrm{ord}}(p)].
\]
